title: Toddler Smearing Mud on Exterior Wall, 1963 B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Kirk - "fun in the mud" 9/63 (25 mo. old)
description: A candid square black-and-white snapshot taken in September 1963 showing a 25-month-old boy named Kirk smearing thick dark mud onto the stucco wall of a residential home. Wearing a short-sleeved polo shirt and heavily soiled diapers, the toddler happily creates handprints and smears on the concrete surface, capturing a humorous moment of innocent early childhood play in 1960s suburban America.
